slides.heading: See your GP first if you notice
items: Pain after a fall or knock

caption:
One big cough and Mr Turtle's ribs grabbed. A hard cough, sneeze or quick twist can strain the small joints and muscles between the ribs.

It's tempting to breathe shallow to avoid the sting, but that can leave you stiffer. Slow deep breaths about once an hour, hugging a pillow when you cough and easy walking can help. Most rib strains settle over a few weeks.

Chest pain with breathlessness, fever, coughing up blood or pain after a fall needs your GP first, and call 000 in an emergency. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help with the rest. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
